parts.desc: HTML 描述标题、段落、按钮、表单等页面内容
parts.desc_en: HTML describes page content such as titles, paragraphs, buttons, forms, etc.

parts.desc: CSS 负责颜色、字体、间距、布局和不同屏幕尺寸
parts.desc_en: CSS takes care of colors, fonts, spacing, layout and different screen sizes

parts.desc: JavaScript 响应操作、保存状态，并向后端请求数据
parts.desc_en: JavaScript responds to operations, saves state, and requests data from the backend

parts.desc: 加载三种代码，把它们组合成用户可以操作的页面
parts.desc_en: Load three types of codes and combine them into pages that users can operate

use.t: 按钮能点、表单能填、操作后页面会变化——这些用户直接使用的部分由前端实现
{c:api} 返回数据后，前端把它变成用户看得懂的卡片、列表和提示
同一份页面要在手机和电脑上都能正常阅读和操作
先把注册、下单等关键流程做通，再补动画、阴影和装饰

dont.t: 不要把数据库密码或服务端密钥写进前端：浏览器获取的前端资源可被用户查看或提取
画面看起来像按钮不等于能用；点击、提交、成功和报错都要真的接通
不要只在浏览器判断价格和权限；请求参数可被篡改，后端应重新检查
简单页面不宜同时引入多套框架；依赖增加会提高升级和排错成本

flowLesson.title: 一次保存经过哪些部分？
flowLesson.instruction: 突出显示的步骤表示当前术语在这条流程里负责的位置。

steps.label: 发出保存请求
steps.detail: 按 API 约定发送地址、方法和数据

steps.label: 接收、检查并处理
steps.detail: 接收请求，检查输入、身份和权限

steps.label: 返回保存结果
steps.detail: 把状态码、结果数据或错误信息组成响应

steps.label: 显示结果
steps.detail: 根据真实响应更新页面

flowLesson.boundary: 前端代码会交给浏览器运行，访问者可以查看或修改；密钥、价格和权限规则不能只放在前端。

practice.title: 页面提示保存成功，刷新后却恢复原样。先检查什么？

options.label: 对照保存请求、成功提示出现时机，以及刷新后的读取响应
options.feedback: 对。三处证据放在一起，才能判断前端是否提前报成功，以及刷新时读回了什么。

options.label: 先清除浏览器缓存并刷新，观察旧值是否还会出现
options.feedback: 缓存可能影响显示，但不能证明保存请求完成，也不能说明刷新读取了哪条记录。

options.label: 把成功提示延迟一秒，再重复保存和刷新
options.feedback: 延迟提示只改变界面时机，不能修复请求失败、提前报成功或刷新读错数据。

flowLesson.agentPrompt: 页面点保存以后会提示成功，但一刷新内容就没了。先检查前端是不是提前显示成功，以及它有没有正确处理保存请求和刷新后的读取结果。找到问题再改，改完重新保存并刷新确认。

en.title: Which parts handle one save?
en.instruction: Highlighted steps show what this term is responsible for in the flow.

steps.label: Edit and save
steps.detail: Read the input and show a pending state

steps.label: Send the request
steps.detail: Use the API contract's URL, method, and data

steps.label: Receive, check, and process
steps.detail: Receive the request and validate the input, identity, and permission

steps.label: Return the result
steps.detail: Return success, failure, and the reason under the API contract

steps.label: Show the result
steps.detail: Update the page from the real response

en.boundary: Frontend code runs in the browser, where visitors can inspect or modify it. Do not keep secrets, trusted prices, or permission rules only there.

practice.title: The page says Saved, but the old value returns after refresh. What should you check first?

options.label: Compare the save request, when success appears, and the response used after refresh
options.feedback: Correct. Together these show whether the UI reported success early and what refresh actually read.

options.label: Clear the browser cache first, then refresh and see whether the old value remains
options.feedback: Cache can affect display, but it does not prove the save completed or identify what refresh read.

options.label: Delay the success message by one second, then repeat save and refresh
options.feedback: Changing message timing does not fix a failed request, early success, or a read of the wrong record.

en.agentPrompt: The page says Saved, but the value disappears after refresh. Check whether the frontend reports success too early and whether it handles the save request and refresh read correctly. Fix the cause, then save and refresh again to verify it.

dont.t: Put secrets or trusted business rules only in browser code
Assume every device and connection behaves the same
Ignore loading, empty, and error states
Mix presentation code with unrelated server responsibilities
